data.name: Consent.Text
data.value:
CAMERA SUPERVISION ACKNOWLEDGEMENT (v1)
I confirm that I am the parent or legal guardian of the child associated with this device, or that I have the family owner's express permission to view this camera.
I will use this camera view only for lawful parental supervision of that child. I will not use it to monitor any other person, and I will not use it in any place where a person has a reasonable expectation of privacy, including bedrooms, bathrooms, changing areas or similar private spaces. I will not record, share, publish or use the feed for harassment, stalking, intimidation or any unlawful purpose.
I understand that camera access is logged with my account, device and time, and that misuse can result in loss of access and legal action. I will comply with all applicable privacy, consent and monitoring laws in my jurisdiction. This notice is not legal advice; I am responsible for confirming that my use is lawful.
By selecting "I agree", I confirm that I have read and accept these conditions.

data.value: Luna AI is a study buddy for your kids. Pick how Luna AI connects, add your key, and test it before turning Luna AI on for a child.

data.name: Luna.Guide.Checks.Text
data.value: Every message your child sends, and every answer Luna AI gives, is checked by a separate safety filter before anyone sees it. The chat AI never sees a blocked message. If the safety filter is down, Luna AI does not answer.

data.name: Luna.Guide.Charge.Text
data.value: You can read every chat, including hidden ones. Blocked messages send you an alert; urgent ones reach you right away by push and email, even in quiet hours.

data.name: Luna.Guide.TwoSetups.Text
data.value: Luna AI needs a chat AI and a safety filter. Setup A uses one OpenRouter key for both and forces zero data retention, so your child's messages are not stored by the AI companies. Setup B lets you use another provider with OpenAI's safety filter, and needs two keys.

data.name: Luna.Guide.Under13.Text
data.value: OpenAI asks apps not to send personal data of children under 13 without zero data retention, which normal keys do not have. Setup A is the recommended choice for younger kids, and asks no extra confirmation.

data.name: Luna.Guide.Cost.Text
data.value: You pay the AI provider directly with your own key. OpenAI's safety filter is free. Llama Guard 4 on OpenRouter costs cents per month for normal use. You can set a monthly limit below.

data.name: Luna.Guide.GetKey.Step3

data.name: Luna.Why.Title
data.value: Why Luna instead of a free AI chat

data.name: Luna.Why.Text
data.value: Sooner or later, kids this age with access to a computer, tablet or phone find an AI chat on their own. Public AI chats are made for everyone, not for kids, and you can't see what your child asks them. Luna meets your child halfway: a real AI they can use every day, with you in charge.

data.name: Luna.Why.Bullet.Kids
data.value: Made for kids: Luna helps them think and learn instead of just giving answers.

data.name: Luna.Why.Bullet.Filter
data.value: Every message and every answer passes a safety filter first.

data.name: Luna.Why.Bullet.Alerts
data.value: You can read every chat and get alerts when something needs you.

data.name: Luna.Why.Bullet.NoAds
data.value: No ads, no account for your child, and zero data retention with Setup A.

data.name: Luna.Why.Bullet.Limits
data.value: Daily limits, schedules and locks apply to Luna too.

data.name: Luna.Why.Footer
data.value: Recommended: turn on Block public AI chats in Websites. It blocks public AI chat and AI companion sites so Luna becomes the AI your child uses.

data.name: Luna.Welcome.Intro
data.value: Luna is an AI study buddy for your kids. It helps with homework and questions about math, science, history, word meanings, languages, or anything they're curious about. It uses your own AI key, follows your family's rules, and you can read every chat.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.OpenAi.Step1
data.value: Sign up or sign in at platform.openai.com.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.OpenAi.Step2
data.value: Open Billing at platform.openai.com/account/billing and add a payment method and credit.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.OpenAi.Step3
data.value: Open API keys at platform.openai.com/settings/organization/api-keys and select Create new secret key.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.OpenAi.Step4
data.value: Name the key "Luna", create it, and copy it.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.OpenAi.Step5
data.value: Paste it in the Chat provider key field above.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Anthropic.Step1
data.value: Sign up or sign in at platform.claude.com.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Anthropic.Step2
data.value: Open Settings > Billing at platform.claude.com/settings/billing and buy credits.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Anthropic.Step3
data.value: Open API keys at platform.claude.com/settings/keys and select Create key.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Anthropic.Step4
data.value: Name the key "Luna", choose an expiration, and copy it (it starts with sk-ant-).

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Anthropic.Step5
data.value: Paste it in the Chat provider key field above.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Gemini.Step1
data.value: Sign in to Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Gemini.Step2
data.value: Open the API keys page at aistudio.google.com/apikey and select Create API key.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Gemini.Step3
data.value: Choose or create a Google Cloud project for the key.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Gemini.Step4
data.value: For the paid tier, link a Cloud Billing account; see ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing. Name the key "Luna" if the page asks for a name, then copy it.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Gemini.Step5
data.value: Paste it in the Chat provider key field above.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.DeepSeek.Step1
data.value: Sign up or sign in at platform.deepseek.com.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.DeepSeek.Step2
data.value: Open Top up at platform.deepseek.com/top_up and add balance.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.DeepSeek.Step3
data.value: Open API keys at platform.deepseek.com/api_keys and select Create new API key.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.DeepSeek.Step4
data.value: Name the key "Luna" and copy it.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.DeepSeek.Step5
data.value: Paste it in the Chat provider key field above.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.ModerationNote
data.value: Luna needs this key unless your chat provider is OpenAI. Moderation itself is free, but OpenAI may require a payment method on the account.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Moderation.Step1

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Moderation.Step2
data.value: Open API keys at platform.openai.com/settings/organization/api-keys, create a key named "Luna moderation", and copy it.

data.name: Luna.SetupB.Moderation.Step3
data.value: Paste it in the OpenAI key for the safety filter field above.
